meta.heading: Plan details
meta.defaultHint: Leave vehicle types empty to make this plan eligible to be the default.

info.planName: Internal name shown in plan lists and to staff — not shown to end customers.
info.timezone: IANA zone (e.g. Europe/Athens) used to convert window times and weekdays to local wall-clock time.
info.graceMinutes: Subtracted from the stay's duration before billing. Stays shorter than this are free; longer stays are billed for duration minus grace.
info.incrementMinutes: After grace is subtracted, billable duration rounds up to the next multiple of this value — e.g. a 61-minute stay with a 15-minute increment bills as 75 minutes.
info.validFrom: Plan becomes eligible for quoting and booking from this date onward. Leave empty for no start limit.
info.validTo: Plan stops being eligible for quoting and booking after this date. Leave empty for no end limit.
info.vehicleTypesLabel: Limits this plan to the selected vehicle types. Leave empty to price every vehicle type — required for the plan to be eligible as default.
info.active: Inactive plans stay saved but can't be assigned to facilities or used for quotes.
info.defaultPlan: Applied automatically to any facility with no plan explicitly assigned. Only available when vehicle types is empty.

rateGrid.heading: Rate grid
rateGrid.hint: Every tier × window needs a price. Empty cells are flagged and rejected on save.

info.currency: Currency used for every price in this grid and in quotes for this plan.
info.tierWindowHeader: Each cell prices one tier during one window. A stay is billed at the tier covering its cumulative duration, using the window active when that charge starts.

caps.heading: Caps (optional)
caps.hint: Clamp totals. Stay = whole stay; rolling = per window bucket (1440 = daily).

info.windowMinutes: Size of the repeating bucket the cap resets on (1440 = once per calendar day). Only used when scope is Rolling window.
info.cap: Maximum amount charged within the cap's scope — once per stay, or once per rolling window bucket.
info.scope: Whole stay caps the total once across the entire booking. Rolling window re-applies the cap on each repeating bucket above, so long stays get capped multiple times.

tiers.heading: Tiers
tiers.hint: Cumulative-duration bands. Each tier starts where the previous ends; the last tier is open-ended.

info.fromMinutes: Set automatically to the previous tier's end — tiers chain contiguously with no gap or overlap.
info.toMinutes: Minute where this tier ends and the next one begins. The last tier is always open-ended.
info.unit: Per minute charges rate × minutes spent in this tier. Per block charges the block rate once per full or partial block. Flat charges the tier's rate once, however long the tier lasts.
info.blockMinutes: Length of one billing block for a per-block tier. Any partial block still costs a full block's rate.

windows.heading: Windows
windows.hint: Time-of-day slots per weekday. Start is inclusive, end exclusive; end ≤ start wraps past midnight.
windows.label: Label
windows.uncoveredWarning: These days are not cleanly tiled across 24h (gap or overlap): {days}. Windows must run end-to-end from 00:00 to 24:00 with no gap or overlap. Pricing will be rejected until fixed.

info.label: Name shown as this window's column header in the rate grid below.
info.days: Weekdays this window applies to. Selected days must be fully covered by windows with no gap or overlap across 24 hours.
info.end: Local time this window ends (exclusive). Set it earlier than start to wrap past midnight.

info.startsAt: Test check-in time for this preview only — does not affect the saved plan.
info.endsAt: Test check-out time for this preview only — does not affect the saved plan.
info.vehicleType: Vehicle type used for this preview quote, limited to the types this plan accepts.
